output.summary: Agency spend growth is mostly volume (77%), driven by a self-reinforcing loop. Vacancies lead to agency use. Agency staff cannot charge or precept, so those duties and buddy orientation fall on permanent RNs. Exhaustion and resignations then rise with a lag of about two quarters, which creates more vacancies. The 4 West pilot, with matched controls, supports this causally. The rise predates St. Brennan's, and pay is a secondary exit reason. The 2025 bonus did not lower vacancies. The proposed bonus, funded by cutting charge and preceptor differentials, would worsen the loop. Extend the 4 West model, and renegotiate the agency escalator as a secondary lever. Do not outsource recruitment yet. Do not bar agency staff from 5 East and 7 North, because the falls link is confounded.
